violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: IN TWO-DOOR PREP TOP OBSERVED RAW FISH AT 72F, CUT LETTUCE AT 71F, CUT TOMATO AT 70F. COOLER WAS ACCIDENTALLY UNPLUGGED THE NIGHT BEFORE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOOD IN THE COOLER DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived alter during inspection

violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. PIC was able to download and show read agreed too and signed EHP’s for all employees

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC agreed to replace handwashing sign

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed stands used for supporting the display heater on the front counter being made out of untreated unsealed lumber and aluminum foil
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC agreed to discard of stand made of aluminum foil and untreated/non sealed lumber

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. Observed at the service line that the flooring had come loose making the flooring not smooth or easily cleanable, observed sub floor of concrete
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. PIC agreed too have flooring repaired by next inspection

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: EHS observed Mahi mahi on the menu, being served in an undercooked form in ceviche, without a parasite destruction letter being provided for fish.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. EHS informed PIC that mahi mahi fish served undercooked form is required to have a parasite destruction letter available. PIC agreed to contact fish supplier and to acquire a parasite destruction letter.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: observed an incomplete consumer advisory on the menu, PIC had a reminder statement and no disclosure that the ceviche on the menu may be served raw or under cooked.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS informed PIC, PIC agreed to add a disclosure statement to the menu.
